# nanoodle

> Build and share reusable AI workflows. A graph is the portable recipe; a browser app is an inputs → Run → outputs interface; an MCP tool is an operation an agent can call.

Choose where you want the workflow to run. The browser editor and apps use your NanoGPT account (OAuth or API key) and bill your NanoGPT balance. Standard model calls go directly from your browser to NanoGPT without a Nanoodle model proxy. Hosted MCP is a separate service: it receives tool inputs and quotes each paid run. Viewing examples and inspecting a graph do not run models.

## Pages
- [Editor](https://nanoodle.com/): the node editor (also reachable at /app and /editor). Build and run workflows; share a graph as a URL.
- [App builder](https://nanoodle.com/play): turns any workflow into a standalone, shareable app — auto inputs, Run, outputs; share via link or export a self-contained .html.
- [Run workflows headlessly](https://nanoodle.com/guide/run-headless): inspect a graph or full share link offline, then run it in your own environment. The package name is `nanoodle` on both npm and PyPI.
- [Terms, Privacy & FAQ](https://nanoodle.com/legal): how it works and what it does (and does not) collect.

## Choose how an agent runs it
- [Call a ready-made workflow on hosted MCP](https://mcp.nanoodle.com/llms.txt): start with a tool that matches the outcome, such as comparing image models, animating a still or making a song. Nano (XNO) is the default on this endpoint; eligible tools support NEAR and USDC on NEAR. Use `tools/list` on the endpoint for the exact tools and schemas.
- [Compose a supported graph on hosted MCP](https://near.nanoodle.com/llms.txt): start with free `noodle_guide` and `price_noodle`, then quote `run_noodle`. This endpoint accepts NEAR or Circle-issued USDC on NEAR, not Nano. It supports a priced subset of the editor's nodes, not arbitrary graphs, file paths or custom endpoints.
- [Give your own recipe a hosted endpoint](https://near.nanoodle.com/creators): upload a graph and expose its named inputs. Nanoodle stores the recipe but does not serve its source to callers. Anyone with the link can quote and pay to run it; the link is not access control.
- [Run one task locally](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle-skill): use the design/run Agent Skill for your own graph or [prebuilt task skills](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/noodle-skills). Inspect an unfamiliar graph before running it with your provider credentials.
- [Install your own MCP server](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle-mcp): point `nanoodle-mcp --graphs` at a folder of saved graphs. Each graph becomes one typed tool; local stdio uses your NanoGPT key or Nano wallet. On self-hosted HTTP, the operator controls access, funding and retention.

## Examples
- [Workflow guides](https://nanoodle.com/guide/examples/): learn how the recipes work and open them in the editor.
- [Reviewed workflow outputs](https://nanoodle.com/examples/gallery/): see the inputs, outputs, observed costs and review limits without paying to run anything.
- [Workflow gallery](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/awesome-noodles): open, inspect and remix saved `noodle-graph.json` recipes.
- [App showcase](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/built-with-nanoodle): try finished browser apps or download their exact graphs.

## Sharing and data
- [Browser privacy](https://nanoodle.com/legal): browser credentials are stored locally and not embedded in exports. A custom endpoint node in the editor sends its inputs to the destination you configure, without sending the NanoGPT API key.
- [Full and shortened links](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanolink): a full editor or app link carries the graph in its URL fragment, which is not sent to the web host. Anyone you share it with can decode it, including defaults. Shortening opts into sending the full link and any preview to the first-party link service. Remove secrets and private samples before sharing or uploading.
- [Hosted MCP privacy and outputs](https://mcp.nanoodle.com/llms.txt): inputs pass through the hosted operator; hosted media is delivered via temporary URLs. This is not the browser privacy model.

## Optional
- [Extended llms-full.txt](https://nanoodle.com/llms-full.txt): editor README, executor quickstarts and the full editor node catalog.
- [JavaScript SDK and CLI](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle-js): `npm install nanoodle`; see the package for current runtime requirements.
- [Python SDK and CLI](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle-py): `pip install nanoodle`; see the package for current runtime requirements.
- [Rust executor](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle-rs): build the reference-compatible executor from source.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/nanoodlecom): source repositories, CI action, read-only embeds and supporting libraries.
- [Submit a workflow](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle/issues/new?template=share-workflow.yml): voluntary public submission; remove credentials and sensitive samples first.
- [Report a problem](https://github.com/nanoodlecom/nanoodle/issues/new?template=workflow-problem.yml): a sanitized share link is optional.
